description: This file defines a GUI window class for displaying and interacting with a coding map in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes a nested view class, methods for loading a map, handling mouse events, and managing area codes, with external dependencies on PySide6 for GUI components and binascii for data decoding.

classes.name: ModifiersCodingMapWindow
classes.description: Main GUI window class for displaying and editing a modifiers coding map, including loading the map, handling user interactions, and managing area polygons.

classes.name: ModifiersCodingMapWindow.View
classes.description: Nested class extending QGraphicsView to handle mouse press events and emit signals.

methods.name: viewMousePressEvent
methods.description: Handles mouse press events on the view, toggling area codes based on clicked polygons.

methods.name: getCodes
methods.description: Returns the current list of area codes as a string.

methods.name: loadMap
methods.description: Loads a bitmap image from base64 data, displays it, and overlays polygons representing areas with specified colors.
